requirementIndex.title: WHEN the `FooterEnvModeBadge` component renders THE SYSTEM SHALL read the value of `import.meta.env.MODE`.
WHEN the component renders THE SYSTEM SHALL apply `.toLowerCase()` to the `import.meta.env.MODE` value before displaying it, rather than trusting its casing as-is.
WHEN the component renders THE SYSTEM SHALL display the lowercased mode value as plain text content with no label prefix (e.g. `development`, not `mode: development`).
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT accept any props on `FooterEnvModeBadge`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT maintain any internal state in `FooterEnvModeBadge`.

WHEN the badge renders THE SYSTEM SHALL apply the pill classes `rounded-full border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--code-bg)] px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-[var(--text)]` to the text-carrying element, identical to `FooterVersionBadge` and `FooterCommitBadge`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT introduce any new CSS custom properties for this badge.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT apply any distinct visual treatment (e.g. color-coding by mode) to the badge.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT set an explicit `z-index` on the badge, matching the other footer badges.
WHEN the badge renders THE SYSTEM SHALL position its outer wrapper with `fixed right-20 bottom-3` so that it sits immediately to the left of `FooterVersionBadge`.
WHEN the app is printed THE SYSTEM SHALL hide the badge via `print:hidden` on the outer wrapper.
WHEN `FooterCommitBadge` renders THE SYSTEM SHALL position its wrapper at `right-44` instead of `right-20`, so it no longer overlaps the env-mode badge.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT change any class, markup, tooltip, fallback handling, or SHA-display behavior of `FooterCommitBadge` beyond the `right-20` → `right-44` offset change.

WHERE the three footer badges (`FooterVersionBadge` at `right-3`, `FooterEnvModeBadge` at `right-20`, `FooterCommitBadge` at `right-44`) are mounted together THE SYSTEM SHALL render them without horizontal overlap.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT alter `FooterVersionBadge`'s markup or offset.
WHEN the badge renders THE SYSTEM SHALL expose the mode text as a plain, screen-reader-visible text node with no `aria-hidden` attribute anywhere in its markup.
WHEN the badge renders THE SYSTEM SHALL set `title="vite mode"` as a static string on the `<span>` element that carries the mode text.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT attach an `onClick` handler or any other interactive event handler to the badge.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT render the badge as or within an `<a>` or `<Link>` element.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT invoke the clipboard API from the badge.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT render a tooltip component or popover for the badge beyond the static `title` attribute.
WHEN the app builds in development mode THE SYSTEM SHALL render the badge.
WHEN the app builds in production mode THE SYSTEM SHALL render the badge with the same markup structure.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT gate the badge's rendering on `import.meta.env.DEV` or `import.meta.env.PROD`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT expose any settings, context, or store entry to configure the badge.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT require any `vite.config.ts` `define` entry for this feature.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT require any new ambient type declaration in `src/vite-env.d.ts` for this feature, relying on Vite's existing `ImportMetaEnv.MODE` typing.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT add any new npm package dependency for this feature.
WHEN the app root renders THE SYSTEM SHALL mount `<FooterEnvModeBadge />` exactly once, from `src/App.tsx`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT mount `FooterEnvModeBadge` from any file other than `src/App.tsx`.

WHEN mounting the footer badges in `src/App.tsx` THE SYSTEM SHALL place `<FooterEnvModeBadge />` between `<FooterVersionBadge />` and `<FooterCommitBadge />`, matching their left-to-right visual order.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT make any markup change to `src/App.tsx` beyond adding the `FooterEnvModeBadge` import and mount.
THE SYSTEM SHALL confine all new files for this feature to `src/components/footer-env-mode-badge/`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT add unrelated code to `src/components/footer-env-mode-badge/`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT modify `src/index.css` or `tailwind.config.ts` as part of this feature.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT modify any file under `src/components/footer-version-badge/` as part of this feature.
WHEN `footer-env-mode-badge.test.tsx` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL verify the badge renders the lowercased `import.meta.env.MODE` value as plain text content.
WHEN `footer-env-mode-badge.test.tsx` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL verify the wrapper element carries `fixed`, `right-20`, `bottom-3`, and `print:hidden` classes.
WHEN `footer-env-mode-badge.test.tsx` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL verify the text-carrying element carries `title="vite mode"`.
WHEN `footer-env-mode-badge.test.tsx` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL verify the pill styling classes (`rounded-full`, `border`, `bg-[var(--code-bg)]`, `text-xs`, `text-[var(--text)]`) are present.
WHEN `footer-env-mode-badge.test.tsx` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL verify no explicit `z-index` class is present on the badge.
WHEN `footer-env-mode-badge.test.tsx` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL verify no interactive elements (`<a>`, `<button>`, `onClick`) are present in the rendered output.
WHEN `footer-env-mode-badge.test.tsx` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL verify no `aria-hidden` attribute is present anywhere in the rendered output.
WHEN `footer-commit-badge.test.tsx` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL assert the wrapper's className contains `right-44` in place of the prior `right-20` assertion.
